## About
Tommy's Auto Body is a full auto body shop on Meekland Ave in Hayward, set up for large and small repairs. We work on all makes and models, foreign or domestic, and we do auto painting and body repair for the City of Hayward and for local dealerships that recommend our work, including Hayward Toyota, Hayward Nissan, Hayward Chevrolet and Shamrock Ford.
Every job starts with a complete, accurate estimate. Sometimes that means a little tear-down so we can see exactly what needs fixing. Then our technicians restore your car to its pre-accident condition using Dupont paint mixed in our computerized paint room, and we finish with a courtesy car wash.
Customers rate us 4.1 on Google from 57 reviews. Give us a call or stop by. We would like to be the shop you come back to.

## Services
- Collision repair: Minor body damage or a major collision, restored to pre-accident condition with quality work and reasonable down time.
- Paint, color matching and spot painting: Dupont paint mixed in our computerized paint room for a close color match, with careful sanding and priming before painting.
- Frame damage repair: Frame damage is diagnosed and repaired right here at our Hayward shop.
- Minor fender benders: For small dents and scrapes, we keep pricing sensible so costs stay down.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. AAA and all auto insurance companies are welcomed, and we take care of the insurance paperwork for you. One reviewer said we handled all the communication with AAA.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: We welcome all makes and models, foreign or domestic.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
